Bug_Title: BIT: Check for sign of bitwise operation involving negative number (BIT_SIGNED_CHECK_HIGH_BIT)
Bug_Details:
This method compares a bitwise expression such as
((val & CONSTANT) > 0) where CONSTANT is the negative number.
Using bit arithmetic and then comparing with the greater than operator can
lead to unexpected results. This comparison is unlikely to work as expected. The good practice is
to use '!= 0' instead of '> 0'.
 ((val & CONSTANT) > 0)
Bug_Explanation: This method compares a bitwise expression such as ((val & CONSTANT) > 0) where CONSTANT is the negative number. Using bit arithmetic and then comparing with the greater than operator can lead to unexpected results. This comparison is unlikely to work as expected. The good practice is to use '!= 0' instead of '> 0'.
Trigger_Explanation: The test case triggers the bug by passing a negative number as the second argument to the'showBug' method. This negative number is compared with another negative number using a bitwise operation which results in unexpected results due to the sign extension during bitwise operation.
